name: receipts-incident
subject: Some of your receipts were deleted or changed

blocks.text: Permaily found that some of the receipts that record what left your mailboxes were deleted or changed in its storage.
Open Activity at app.permaily.com to see which. Your receipts after them are still recorded, and Permaily's public check now fails until this is looked into.
To ask about it, write to support@permaily.com.
